profile.reading: These two OpenStreetMap points near New Albany, in Franklin County, Ohio, are both tagged telecom=data_center and both carry the name Compugen. Compugen Inc. is a real, Canadian-based IT solutions provider and managed-services reseller that sells and supports hardware, cloud, and IT infrastructure for enterprise customers, including a presence in the greater Columbus, Ohio market, which has become a significant data-center hub in its own right due to major hyperscaler investment nearby (Google, Meta, and Amazon all operate large campuses in the New Albany area). However, being an IT reseller and services company is a different business from operating a commercial data center: Compugen's own facility in this area is most plausibly an office, warehouse, or hardware staging and logistics site supporting its reseller and managed-services business, not a colocation or cloud facility housing customer server racks. The existence of two separate, closely spaced OSM points under the identical name suggests a mapping duplication (the same premises entered twice, or an office and an adjacent parking or logistics area both tagged) rather than two genuinely distinct sites, though this could not be confirmed against Compugen's own published address this session. Both records are treated as the same probable office mistag pending further confirmation.
